During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in which the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|empire]] of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Vong '''attacked''' the [[Tsyk system/Legends|Tsyk system]] within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The attack took place some time between the years [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], and the Vong reached the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by traveling down the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] from a previous [[Attack on the Hollastin system|attack]] on the [[Hollastin system/Legends|Hollastin system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Tsyk system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book released in [[2009]] and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The battle is not mentioned in the text of the book but is shown on a map called "Collapse of [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]]" which details conflicts of the Yuuzhan Vong War that took place in the galaxy somewhen between 26 ABY and 27 ABY. No information is given about the outcome of the attack, although a separate map shows the Tsyk system was under Vong control by 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />
